correctness.rationale: At any putative equilibrium with I_c=I_ck=0, S cannot vanish because Sdot=Λ+πR>0 there. Then the I_c equation forces H=0, the H equation forces I_k=0 because ζ_k>0, and the I_k equation reduces to 0=λ_k S, contradicting λ_k>0 and S>0. Exact baseline substitution independently gives S0=356000/360017 and I_k-dot=20826/9000425>0 at the source’s displayed E0. This is a symbolic contradiction, not a numerical simulation.

originality.rationale: Rao et al.’s full 2026 primary PDF was materially inspected at System (2.1), the displayed disease-free point, the stability theorems and the parameter table. The printed equations themselves contain the contradiction: positive background CKD incidence feeds I_k, CKD hospitalization feeds the aggregate H class, and the entire H is placed in the COVID force of infection. The paper nevertheless treats a zero-I_k, zero-H point as the full-system disease-free equilibrium. A related 2024 COVID/CKD model uses explicitly COVID-infected compartments in the force of infection and does not imply this correction. Resultary searches found no prior source-specific no-equilibrium theorem.
residual_risks: A later correction to the 2026 paper could change the printed hospital compartment or force of infection; the claim is explicitly about the published System (2.1).

value.rationale: The defect invalidates the base point for the paper’s central invasion-threshold and stability analysis in its positive-background-CKD calibration. Identifying the precise aggregate-hospital mechanism and the necessary modeling repair is a substantive source correction, not a cosmetic algebra check.

final_claim: For Rao et al.’s printed 2026 COVID/CKD System (2.1), if Λ,β_c,λ_k,ζ_k are positive and 0≤ε_v≤1, there is no nonnegative equilibrium with I_c=I_ck=0; in particular the paper’s displayed E0 is not a full-system equilibrium when λ_k>0, so full-system threshold/stability statements around E0 do not apply to the printed calibrated model.
scientific_limitations: A later correction to the 2026 paper could change the printed hospital compartment or force of infection; the claim is explicitly about the published System (2.1).
The theorem diagnoses the printed system only and does not derive a replacement reproduction number or stability theorem for a repaired model.
The special axes λ_k=0, ζ_k=0 or β_c=0 are excluded.
